title: Compliance Holds on Mobile Wallet Transfers: Tier Parameters
content:
Compliance desk parameter sheet for **Mobile Wallet** transfers held with a transfer-level request for information.

| Tier | Calendar days to answer a request for information before the transfer is cancelled | Share of each booking fee refunded when Paloma cancels a held transfer (percent) | Paloma business days compliance takes to clear a hold once the request is answered |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Micro | 7 | 100 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Economy | 10 | 100 | 2 |
| Mobile Wallet Express | 7 | 100 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Express Plus | 7 | 100 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Priority | 7 | 100 | 1 |
| Mobile Wallet Large Amount | 14 | 100 | 3 |

- The answer period is counted in calendar days.
- The review period is counted in Paloma business days and starts once the request for information has been answered.
- The booking-fee refund share applies to each booking fee when Paloma itself cancels a held transfer; on every Mobile Wallet tier it is 100 percent.

*Hypothetical reading:* a Mobile Wallet Large Amount transfer gives the customer 14 calendar days to answer and allows compliance 3 business days to clear the hold after a complete answer; a Mobile Wallet Economy transfer gives 10 days and 2 business days.
